mission_07: Excellent! You have implemented a feature store that encapsulates the core concepts of centralized feature management. By registering feature pipelines with metadata, fitting them consistently, and providing retrieval by name, your feature store ensures that the same transformations are used across all models and environments. The export functionality provides a machine-readable specification that can be version-controlled and shared across teams. While production feature stores like Feast add capabilities like online/offline stores, point-in-time correctness, and monitoring, the fundamental pattern of registering, fitting, and retrieving feature transformations remains the same. Understanding these concepts prepares you for working with enterprise ML infrastructure and building scalable, maintainable feature engineering systems.
